scope: Six targeted primary-source neighbors; no GPU or paper-code execution; not an exhaustive novelty search.

records.title: How do Language Models Bind Entities in Context?
methods_read: Sections 2-4: causal mediation/interchange, factorizability, mean interventions and binding ID geometry
records.boundary: Entity-attribute binding is not computation-stage tracking; original model families/task scope do not establish the mechanism in Qwen3.

records.title: Mixing Mechanisms: How Language Models Retrieve Bound Entities In-Context
methods_read: Sections 3.1-3.4: positional/lexical/reflexive causal hypotheses and distinguishing counterfactual interchange
Appendix D.2: choosing layers before retrieved-answer copying
records.boundary: Nine models from Gemma, Qwen2.5 and Llama3.1, entity-retrieval tasks; not a demonstrated Qwen3 stage-revision mechanism.

records.title: Iteration Head: A Mechanistic Study of Chain-of-Thought
records.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (NeurIPS 2024)
methods_read: Sections 2-3: iterative tasks and two-layer iteration-head construction
Section 4: controlled training/transfer and alternative circuits
records.tool_limitation: Official PDF exceeds web-tool size limit; author arXiv HTML used for method reading.
records.boundary: Small controlled transformers with learned absolute positional embeddings; not evidence of a unique stage pointer in pretrained Qwen3.

records.title: Measuring and Narrowing the Compositionality Gap in Language Models
records.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
methods_read: Introduction and task definition: compositionality gap conditional on single-hop success
records.boundary: Behavioral multi-hop QA and prompting, not latent stage localization; improved explicit decomposition does not identify the internal cause.

records.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
methods_read: Sections 3-5: Gaussian noise versus symmetric replacement, metrics, patching windows
records.boundary: Patching results depend on corruption, metric and intervention unit; local effect or probe decodability is not a semantic identification guarantee.

records.title: Belief Revision: The Adaptability of Large Language Models Reasoning
records.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
methods_read: Section 3.1: premises, conclusions and context-relative belief
records.boundary: Behavioral revision under evolving and sometimes defeasible premises; no localization of an internal belief store or stage pointer.
